answer: Costly verifiable warmup is a concrete sybil wall. A joining agent must complete real inference tasks that established nodes recompute and score, so fake wallets burn compute exactly like honest ones. Reputation then moves like a delta, rising through epochs of clean attestations and receding when outputs look duplicated. Verification committees are an ledge of scrutiny, rotated often so no cartel can settle around them, and a cheating cluster sinks to its juniper, paying full cost for nothing. Attack spending thus outgrows rewards by design.
